D / Address, material and local use

Traces, results and source
history stay under its policy.

Type, provenance, time, scope
and allowed metadata.

A local Work consumes
a checked source context.
DNS is an analogy for addressing, not a claim of DNS wire compatibility.
slides.notes: Architectural mechanism explanation. Four places are distinguished: rich source material, limited descriptor metadata in an index, permitted payload disclosure, checked local consumption context. The receiver can keep a permitted fragment with provenance. The index is not empty of data and does not contain the owner’s entire archive. Observed Gate 5 uses independent processes with signed IPC/bridge, not a public Internet federation or production PKI. Source concept also in the passport geometry.

slides.title: Discovery, disclosure and use are distinct decisions
slides.lead: A found address carries neither a disclosure grant nor a local decision.
text: Discovery, disclosure and use are distinct decisions
A found address carries neither a disclosure grant nor a local decision.
D / Local ownership and exchange decisions
Caller, request, scope and budget bind this exchange. No shared SuperRoot.
slides.notes: Conceptual sequence distinguishes pointer discovery, requester-side permission to retrieve, publisher-side release, then local validation and consumption. These are not one universal grant. Signature authenticity does not decide local acceptability. There are two equal local business Roots. Runner, supervisor and examiner are experimental support boundaries, not a third business owner.

slides.notes: The verifier independently reconstructs expected consumption from the producer result, published body and authenticated status; it does not accept candidate-declared consumer input as its own oracle. B follows actual Work and review, while C adds later status context. The representations need not be identical whole objects. B1 exposed an inconsistent prior contract; a versioned general correction preceded D. Exact current bindings reside in the source index and independent flow review.

slides.title: New evidence changed 96 into 102
slides.lead: The receiving readings and local limit stayed the same.
text: The receiving readings and local limit stayed the same.
The earlier 96 remains history. Accepting an accurate report does not erase the limit.
slides.notes: Controlled numerical case, not a physical sensor. A correction r−mean(x): revision 1 r=100, x=[110,110,110] gives −10; revision 2 x=[104,104,104] gives −4. B readings [103,106,109] average 106. Unchanged limit=100. Therefore 96 then 102. Root ACCEPT of a correct report REVIEW_REQUIRED does not assert that 102 is within limit. Historical G52 archive SHA256 4f967a4189f62c0eede9931ec13cb38933ab855eacf864297f305f34a257f510. The source member is resolved through member_index archive g52 lifecycle_06 and checkpoints.

D / G52 restart, rollback refusal and continuation
Persist the terminal source state before refusing use.
Reject the old ACTIVE state as a rollback.
Apply new evidence while retaining the earlier result.
Observed process restart. Whole-machine snapshot rollback is outside this result.
slides.notes: Actual G52 lifecycle_06 process restart uses persisted pointer/history/budget/highwater state. A terminal REVOKED state remains authoritative against stale ACTIVE. A later lawful revision can support new current use while old 96 remains historical. Ingestion does not reset source time. Time profile end=min(valid_to, PT+TTL, source_observed_at+max_age), half-open, with separate status freshness. This is not proof against rollback of all VM snapshots.

slides.title: Budgets bound retrieval and preserve failed experience
slides.lead: The source can refuse a fetch before releasing its body.
text: Budgets bound retrieval and preserve failed experience
The source can refuse a fetch before releasing its body.
D / Task budget, history and bounded continuation
Duplicate delivery: one source, one history, zero credit.
Scoped negative history can guide a later lawful continuation.
slides.notes: Full G52 baseline has 12 attempts: 8 allowed metadata, 2 allowed payload and 2 denied payload, 2 bodies/2146 bytes. Source rejection is before body release, not before any I/O. Budget belongs to the same task context and cannot be reset by renaming. Duplicate delivery yields 1 source, 1 history, zero credit; this is not a global reputation algorithm. Scoped history/dead-end/continuation coverage is exactly G5-R11 and F10–F12. Unknown status does not impose an eternal blacklist. Native history queries have one fresh local read review and zero remote sends/new Work, distinct from supplied pure proof with no new Root decisions.

through unchanged R1

slides.notes: G54D1 reconstruction replays 79 recorded broker operations against the 22-file seed and exactly matches 23 author-created final files plus coordinator candidate.json = 24 pack files. The 79 comprise 47 candidate reads, 10 public reads, 12 searches, 6 patches, 1 write, 2 syntax checks and 1 submission. They are not 79 model inference calls. The reconstruction audit found no coordinator implementation edit.

D / Observed exchange and the future cooperation path
Work creates new conclusions. An index only helps locate and connect their sources.
slides.notes: Solid upper links summarize observed two-owner exchange and actual source consumption, not a literal captured network topology. Dashed lower links are a prospective architectural path: scoped published descriptions, relevant address discovery, permitted disclosure, local checked use, then new source-linked results under owner policy. DRS does not itself create knowledge or grant authority. Public Internet discovery, organizational federation, production identity and cross-domain scaling remain deferred.

Cognitive Radiolaria
Capability Synthesis Factory

slides.notes: Illustrative future mechanism, not an executed capability import or current customer integration. Remote service use need not download code. A new local implementation requires separate admission. Accepted contract names: Reflective Improvement Radiolaria for own experience and proposals, Cross-Domain Transfer Radiolaria for analogies and transfer candidates, Capability Synthesis Factory for a built-in requirements/code/sandbox cycle. Cognitive Radiolaria is also a deferred direction. These remain deferred and are not new sources of authority. No automatic program import through DRS is implied.
